scheme_name: Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award
other_conditions: The library must have been in existence for at least 15 years.
The library must have a minimum of 100 registered members for the last 5 years.
The library must hold at least 2,500 books, periodicals, etc., in readable condition.
The library must have proper infrastructure with retrieval facilities and a minimum area of 40 sq. mts with adequate ventilation.
The library must conduct regular programmes to enhance reading habits and maintain up‑to‑date records.
The librarian must be born in Goa or have resided in Goa for at least 15 years.
The librarian must have at least 10 years of continuous service as a librarian or section‑in‑charge in a Goa government or government‑aided library.
The librarian must have taken initiatives for library development or reading‑culture promotion.
The award is not conferred posthumously except if death occurs after nomination, in which case it may be awarded within one year of death or retirement.
benefits_summary: Cash prize of ₹50,000 with a memento, citation and certificate for the best library, and cash prize of ₹25,000 with a memento, citation and certificate for the best librarian.
